biotools.summary: GNT Guide-Seq is a pipeline for analyzing GUIDE-Seq data and similar techniques used to detect CRISPR/Cas9 off-targets. It offers rapid and versatile processing of multiplexed libraries and includes tools for bulge management, multi-hit read handling, and off-target prediction.
